exclusion_detail: Lead 15b (oxadiazolylthio acetamide with 4-chlorophenyl) needs 5 reactions: (1) dimedone + p-phenylenediamine -> 1; (2) 1 + chloroacetyl chloride -> 2; (3) ethyl 4-chlorobenzoate + hydrazine hydrate -> 4-chlorobenzohydrazide 11b; (4) 11b + CS2/KOH -> 5-(4-chlorophenyl)-1,3,4-oxadiazole-2-thiol 12b; (5) 2 + 12b (KI, K2CO3, acetone) -> 15b. All have procedures in Section 4.1.1, 4.1.2, 4.1.10, 4.1.11, 4.1.14.

lead.label: 15b
lead.why: Abstract: 'Compounds 5a, 15b, and 16b showed significant inhibitory activity ... compound 15b exhibited superior activity than Quizartinib (AC220)'; 15b is the compound taken furthest (docking, 'anticancer candidate for further in vivo').

notes: Lead named in abstract as 15b (along with 5a and 16b); 15b is the one said to beat Quizartinib, so it is chosen under rule 1. 5a is also named but 15b is the one with the superiority claim.
